questions.question_text: According to Section 1, how can digital skills enhance a college application?

options.text: By ensuring automatic acceptance into top schools
By showcasing tech-savviness through polished essays, presentations, or online course certificates
By replacing the need for extracurricular activities
By focusing only on gaming skills to demonstrate creativityCorrect Answer: B) By showcasing tech-savviness through polished essays, presentations, or online course certificates

questions.question_text: Based on Section 2, what is a key benefit of using AI tools like LinkedIn Learning for career exploration?

options.text: They guarantee a job offer after completing a course
They provide personalized career suggestions and skill-building courses based on your interests
They eliminate the need to attend college for career preparation
They focus solely on tech-related careers, ignoring other fieldsCorrect Answer: B) They provide personalized career suggestions and skill-building courses based on your interests

questions.question_text: What is a recommended way to stay updated on new apps and tech trends, as discussed in Section 3?

options.text: Ignoring tech news to avoid information overload
Following tech channels on YouTube or subscribing to newsletters like TechCrunch for updates
Only using apps that friends recommend without further research
Spending hours daily on social media to spot trendsCorrect Answer: B) Following tech channels on YouTube or subscribing to newsletters like TechCrunch for updates

questions.question_text: In Section 4, what is a key aspect of developing a “learn as you go” attitude for technology?

options.text: Mastering every tech tool before using it in real scenarios
Avoiding new technology to prevent making mistakes
Embracing curiosity and adaptability by learning through trial and error
Relying solely on teachers to explain all tech conceptsCorrect Answer: C) Embracing curiosity and adaptability by learning through trial and error

questions.question_text: According to Section 5, what is an important consideration when building a mini digital portfolio of high school projects?

options.text: Including every project ever completed to show quantity
Selecting 3-5 high-quality pieces with descriptions of your role and lessons learned
Using only paid platforms to ensure a professional look
Sharing personal details like your home address for authenticityCorrect Answer: B) Selecting 3-5 high-quality pieces with descriptions of your role and lessons learned

questions.question_text: What is a general benefit of mastering digital and AI skills, as highlighted in the chapter conclusion?

options.text: It guarantees immediate success in any career field
It prepares you to stand out in college applications, jobs, and future opportunities through adaptability
It eliminates the need for traditional education
It ensures you’ll never face tech-related challengesCorrect Answer: B) It prepares you to stand out in college applications, jobs, and future opportunities through adaptability
